title: The SELF-fuelled decoder inverts the numbering (OPEN, and NOT reachable from the size bound; the fuel-additive round trip IS proved)
statement: FO.Formula.decode : Nat -> FO.Formula, which is decodeAux n n -- the code is its own fuel -- inverts the Goedel numbering: decode (code p) = p for every formula p. STILL NOT PROVED, and the reason changed. The FUEL-ADDITIVE round trip IS now proved (F:fo-formula-decode-code, F:fo-term-decode-code): decodeAux (Nat.add f (size p)) (code p) = p for every f. What that does NOT give is the self-fuelled wrapper, which would need Nat.le (size p) (code p) -- and that statement is FALSE, measured: FO.Formula.code FO.Formula.bot and FO.Term.code (FO.Term.var 0) are both Nat.zero while both sizes are 1, pinned by Kernel::def_eq in fo_roundtrip/tests.rs::size_is_not_bounded_by_the_code. So ADR-1640's item (3) is not an unproved lemma but a refuted one, and the remaining route is different work: a strong induction on the code using Nat.lt (FO.Code.snd n) n -- true, because FO.Code.pair a b is strictly larger than b -- which needs monotonicity of FO.Code.tri, a Nat.lt development on top of it, and a well-founded Nat recursion. That is a slice, not a step, and it buys only the removal of one Nat argument from four statements, which is why this lane routed every downstream theorem through fuel-explicit siblings (FO.Code.substCodeAux, FO.Code.isFormulaCodeAux, FO.Code.diagAux) instead.

formal.statement: theorem FO.Formula.decode_code_self_fuelled : ((x0 : FO.Formula) -> Eq.{1} FO.Formula (FO.Formula.decode (FO.Formula.code x0)) x0)

provenance.source: this row records the measured remaining gap after lane arithmetization landed the numbering, its injectivity and the decoder CONSTRUCTION (W3-7, ADR-1640)

prior_art.what: arithmetization of syntax, in which decoding is done by primitive-recursive functions built from a pairing's projections
prior_art.where: Goedel, 'Ueber formal unentscheidbare Saetze der Principia Mathematica und verwandter Systeme I', Monatshefte fuer Mathematik und Physik 38 (1931)
prior_art.attribution: standard textbook attribution; this lane did not consult the primary source

notes:
THE STATEMENT IS AUTHORED, NOT EXTRACTED, and is deliberately named FO.Formula.decode_code_self_fuelled: the name FO.Formula.decode_code now EXISTS in the kernel with a DIFFERENT type (the fuel-additive round trip, F:fo-formula-decode-code), and the two must not be confused. FO.Formula.decode_code_self_fuelled does not exist, so the binder indices above are this lane's and not Kernel::render_lean's.

WHAT ADR-1648 SETTLED OF ADR-1640'S THREE ITEMS. (1) The size functions plus the fuel-additive round trip: DONE, and the fuel-on-the-LEFT prediction was right and is load-bearing -- the mutation putting it on the right makes the kernel reject the theorem. (2) One transport per tag along FO.Code.fst_pair / snd_pair: DONE, and this was indeed what the thirteen minors are made of. (3) size p <= code p: REFUTED, see the statement above. Two of three predictions right, one false in a way that only building it could show.

WHAT IS NO LONGER BLOCKED BY THIS ROW. The commuting lemma is proved (F:fo-subst-code-commutes), the image lemma for isFormulaCode is proved, and the diagonal identity is proved (F:fo-diagonal-identity) -- all at explicit fuel. Nothing downstream is waiting on the self-fuelled wrapper; it is a convenience, not a prerequisite.

WHAT THE ARITHMETIZATION ALREADY BUYS THE HENKIN CONSTRUCTION. F:fo-completeness-henkin lists 'an enumeration of FO.Formula and a decidable equality on it' as one of its two obstructions. An injection FO.Formula -> Nat is the half that needs no Classical.em and is proved; a decoder with a proved round trip is now the other half, at explicit fuel. The remaining obstruction there -- Lindenbaum's lemma needing excluded middle at every step -- is untouched by any of this.
